system.story: The cyberware specialist - as much a mechanic of the body as a healer.

description.value:
Subclass: Ripperdoc. The flesh-side of the installer trio, leaned all the way in - the one who installs the crew's chrome on a back-room table.

Role Feature - Under the Knife

You are the premier chrome installer/repairer: edges on install/repair/removal downtime projects, reduced botch risk, access to rarer implants. Your flesh work extends to Cyborgs' organic components - surgery a normal doc cannot perform. You keep the Operator's wired reflexes running and install the crew's Chrome Packages.

Signature Tweak

First Aid / Diagnose work on chrome-heavy patients and partial-Cyborgs where others struggle.

Bonus Skill & Contact

A cybertech/mechanics skill, plus a chop-shop, ripperdoc-network, or chrome-fence contact.

Corp Records

Cybersurgery - unlicensed street practice.
